preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner of the TokenTool contract.
A victim user must hold a non-zero balance of the token to perform a sell transaction.

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the `setSelTaxes` function to set the sell fees to an extremely high value, for example, `setSelTaxes(33, 33, 33)` to achieve a 99% total sell fee. Subsequently, when a user sells the token on a decentralized exchange, the `takeFee` function will divert 99% of their tokens to the contract address. These captured tokens are then converted to native currency (BNB) and transferred to the owner-controlled marketing and team wallets through the `swapAndLiquify` mechanism, which is triggered during transfers, thus increasing the attacker's native currency balance.
